title: ORYX
summary: A bold identity for an ERP platform, built on strength, agility and precision: smart solutions, seamless success.
body:
ORYX ERP is an integrated enterprise resource planning system that helps organisations simplify complex operations and manage their business with more clarity.

The challenge was to give a strong, recognisable face to something abstract: software that connects accounts, stock, sales and people. The identity had to feel dependable and precise, without the cold, generic look common to business software.

We started from the oryx, an animal known for strength, resilience and agility. Its head is drawn as a single geometric line inside a hexagon, a form that holds stability and movement together and hints at the way an ERP brings separate operations into one platform. A bold, custom-styled wordmark completes the logo and stays clear at every size.

The palette leads with Heavy Metal, a near-black that carries stability and professionalism, set against a Red Orange that brings energy and ambition, with Morning Glory adding a fresh, cool contrast. Montserrat, from Light to Black, gives the brand a modern, legible voice, and a set of line icons covers code, data and workflow.

The system runs from building signage and billboards to posters, stationery, ID badges, lanyards and social media, all carrying the same line: smart solutions, seamless success.
